H02.diagnosis: The public conformance check establishes a provider-selection mismatch: the plan selects runner-b where the separately authored expectation pins runner-a. The other three listed selections agree. It does not establish a Runner contract or descriptor incompatibility.
H02.smallestRepair: Under the supplied expectation, restore runner-a as the selected provider of fixture/session/runner and therefore as the session root's runner binding. Preserve the three selections that already agree. The four reported differences describe the same substitution and do not justify four independent repairs or changes to either runner implementation or the shared contract.
H02.repairOwner: Composition/provider-selection owner; preserve the correct A oracle and the three agreeing selections.
unknowns: Which composition file or upstream input caused runner-b to be selected.
Whether selecting runner-b was intentional and the expectation is stale.
Any behavior, lifecycle, or implementation defect in either runner.

H03.readerScope: Same separate fresh diagnostician; only the in-flight public owner observation, recipe and file map.
H03.diagnosis: This is an in-flight stopping observation of attempt p7-held-startup. Startup is still pending after cancellation was requested. The observed ingress is closed, with zero publications and zero active work. These facts do not constitute a completed startup, stop, or cleanup result.
H03.supportedAttribution: The pending state belongs to the identified retained attempt. The recipe assigns per-run startup, cancellation, publication and cleanup authority to its owner; the file map names semantic/tests/support/attempt-owner.ts for that role.
H03.unsupportedAttribution: Neither the responsible internal component nor a faulty source location can be inferred. The observation does not establish whether construction, readiness, cancellation handling, or another awaited operation is holding startup. It does not establish a deadlock, leak, completed cancellation, or a reusable-preparation defect.
evidenceRequestedBeforeCompletion: A settled startup outcome for this same attempt.
A completed stop/join result showing startup and accepted operations have been accounted for.
A complete cleanup report accounting for resource closure, together with evidence that the borrowed journal was closed in the required order.
A final public owner observation consistent with those results and closed ingress; the snapshot alone is insufficient.

transport.observation: The successful H03 cleanup receipt precedes completion of the controller stdin transport; EOF/process exit is a separate transport observation.
